2610.04927.title: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems
2610.04927.paper_summary:
Agentic machine learning engineering (MLE) is an emerging AI4SE application for complex ML tasks and a step toward recursive self-improvement of AI systems. Recent agentic MLE systems show the value of leveraging insights from related MLE tasks: some systems condition code generation on expert domain knowledge, which is implicitly curated from peer MLE tasks; some systems have a loop of solving an MLE task, gathering memory to benefit future tasks. However, insight collection and injection remain ad hoc, and existing evaluations often do not control insight sources, making data leakage a threat to validity.
  To close these gaps, we systematically study how insights from related MLE tasks affect agentic MLE systems, and how their impact depends on insight type and injection method. We introduce MLE-InsightBench, a benchmark of 160 Kaggle competitions across 12 domains. To prevent leakage, one competition per domain is held out as the target, while the remaining 148 serve as sources only when they cannot have been influenced by the target task, such as through later editions or reused solutions. We also develop MLE-InsightForge, an insight assembly agent that explores source competitions, top human solutions, and writeups to construct three insight types: 12 domain insights summarizing best practices, 148 competition insights describing winning solutions, and 16 improvement insights capturing generic debugging and optimization strategies. These insights are injected either as on-demand skills or as an upfront playbook. In our evaluation, the extracted insights improve the normalized private-test score by 123.9% over a no-insight baseline. Controlled experiments further show that the three insight types are complementary; the better injection mode (skill vs. playbook) varies by tasks, with skills more cost-effective overall; and the gains generalize across backend LLMs.
2610.04927.paper_summary_zh: 代理機器學習工程（MLE）是一種新興的AI4SE應用，用於複雜的機器學習任務，並且是AI系統遞歸自我改進的一步。最近的代理MLE系統顯示出利用相關MLE任務的洞見的價值：一些系統基於專家領域知識來進行代碼生成，而這些知識是從同行MLE任務中隱式整理而來；一些系統則有一個解決MLE任務的循環，收集記憶以惠及未來的任務。然而，洞見的收集和注入仍然是臨時的，現有的評估往往不控制洞見來源，這使得數據洩漏成為有效性的威脅。<lb/>為了填補這些空白，我們系統地研究了相關MLE任務的洞見如何影響代理MLE系統，以及它們的影響如何依賴於洞見類型和注入方法。我們引入了MLE-InsightBench，一個涵蓋12個領域的160個Kaggle競賽的基準。為了防止洩漏，每個領域保留一個競賽作為目標，而其餘148個僅在未受目標任務影響的情況下作為來源，例如通過後續版本或重用解決方案。我們還開發了MLE-InsightForge，一個洞見組合代理，探索源競賽、頂級人類解決方案和寫作，以構建三種洞見類型：12個領域洞見總結最佳實踐，148個競賽洞見描述獲勝解決方案，以及16個改進洞見捕捉通用的調試和優化策略。這些洞見作為按需技能或作為前期手冊進行注入。在我們的評估中，提取的洞見使得標準化的私有測試分數比無洞見基準提高了123.9%。控制實驗進一步顯示，這三種洞見類型是互補的；更好的注入模式（技能與手冊）因任務而異，整體上技能更具成本效益；而且這些增益在不同的後端LLM中具有普遍性。
